P transmits a radio signal to Q. Relative to the Earth’s surface, Q is stationary and P moves at a speed of 0.70c as shown.

a State, using Galilean relativity, the speed of the radio signal relative to Q. [1]

b Determine, using relativistic velocity addition, the speed of the radio signal relative to Q. [2]

c
